prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Watch your pet react in real-time right on your desktop desktop ecosystem.", "Play pet sound preview"]
1: ["Already adopted a pet? Sign in with your original social or email account to restore your saved companion.", "Cloud Save Active"]
2: ["Have You Adopted Before?", "Select your status so we can instantly connect your existing pet profile or set up a new home.", "Account Status Choice"]
3: ["Choose Your Unique Companion", "Every companion comes with exclusive desktop interactions and starter personality perks!", "+10% Mood Boost Starter Perk", "Listen to pet greeting"]
4: ["Dress Up Your New Friend", "Pick a starting accessory to give your pet its unique style on your desktop.", "Accessories", "Confirm Companion Style"]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially ready for registration to your desktop environment!", "Verified Pet Companion"]
6: ["Preparing Your Desktop Workspace", "Rendering pet animations, audio engine, and taskbar interaction modules...", "Checking GPU overlay permissions", "Loading desktop pet sprites"]
7: ["Readiness Chime"]
8: ["Your Pet Has Arrived!", "Your pet is now active on your screen! Look at your taskbar or click your pet to start interacting.", "Start Playing Now"]
9: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Click to pet, drag to relocate around your screen, or right-click the taskbar icon to send your pet to sleep.", "Finish Onboarding"]
